title: Replica Phase Transition with Quantum Gravity Corrections
summary: Motivated by bulk replica wormholes, we study the boundary effective theory that describes the near-horizon fluctuations of a near-extremal Reissner-Nordström black hole. This theory consists of a Schwarzian mode and a $U(1)$ phase mode. We compute the partition function of this boundary theory on connected geometries, from which the entropy is derived.
